snippet.title: Roadhouse Simulator - Official Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Before the legend, there was the road.

Step into the untold story behind the uncle from Gas Station Simulator. Roadhouse Simulator takes you to the harsh beginnings along Route 66, where survival means more than just keeping the lights on. Start as a bouncer in a forgotten roadhouse, face ruthless biker gangs, manage a lawless business, and fight your way toward control and respect.

Run the bar, handle the heat in the kitchen, expand your territory, and decide when fists speak louder than words. Every choice shapes your rise—and your reputation.

This is where it all began.
Welcome to Roadhouse Simulator.

👉 Wishlist now and stay tuned for more.
